A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same research work. Their main text, equations, tables, figures and appendices A–G support reliable comparison after matching relocated and renumbered content.

before.justification: v2 reports original sparse-approximation, classification, graph-learning and synthetic experiments, including extensive appendix results.

after.justification: v3 retains those original experiments and adds backbone comparisons, independent-MST results and intermediate hierarchy visualizations.

M1.justification: The alternating tree/TWD updates, Haar-filtering rule, regularization and fixed-hierarchy variant remain unchanged. The additional backbone tests and annotated algorithms do not document a changed learning procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same document, scRNA-seq, hierarchical-graph, gene-expression clustering and synthetic recommendation data and tasks. The added appendix experiments reuse this coverage.

E2.justification: v3 Table 15 adds Independent MST to the representation-quality comparison with Co-MST-TWD and Algorithm 2. Table 14 adds Algorithm-2-initialized GCN and GraphSAGE variants; the plain backbones already appeared in v2 Table 3.

E3.justification: Appendix F.13 adds initialization experiments using GCN and GraphSAGE, and F.14 adds an independent-tree control. Existing splits, metrics, kNN settings and hyperparameter grids are retained.

E4.justification: v3 adds focused checks of transfer across backbones, independent versus jointly refined MST representations, and intermediate trees for the existing recommendation example (F.13–F.15). Earlier filtering, convergence, regularization and runtime analyses remain.

E5.justification: Both versions specify five classification trials and ten random graph splits. Existing uncertainty reporting is retained, and the additional result rows do not introduce a new statistical estimation or reporting procedure.

E6.justification: All prior numerical result rows and plotted results are retained. v3 adds backbone and Independent-MST scores and intermediate tree snapshots. New Table 14 includes lower LP means for initialized GCN on PUBMED (90.5 versus 91.1) and initialized GraphSAGE on AIRPORT (90.2 versus 90.4), alongside improvements elsewhere.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions, Theorems 1–2, regularization conditions and supporting appendix proofs remain substantively unchanged. Differences in the proof text are wording and citation edits.

C1.justification: The abstract, four introductory contributions and conclusion retain the same claims about joint hierarchical learning, Haar filtering, convergence and HGCN applications. The new appendix evidence does not redefine the central contributions.

C2.justification: v3 adds interpretations of backbone transfer, cross-mode distribution comparison and branch-level transport costs (F.13–F.15 and G.4). Section 7 explicitly adds asymmetric data to the applicability limitations and differentiable TWD to future directions.

D1.justification: Appendix E retains the initialization choices, parameter grids, filtering thresholds, landmark scaling and implementation information. The new experiments do not supply distinct implementation or resource-access instructions.

R1.justification: v3 expands citations concerning neuroscience, broader and asymmetric geometries, differentiable TWD and alternative graph distances. Its central positioning relative to WSV, Tree-WSV and existing TWD methods remains unchanged.

P1.justification: Edits clarify data modes and example hierarchies, shorten background passages, add descriptive algorithm titles and introduce focused appendix subsections. The overall narrative structure is retained, while citations change from author–year to numbered style.

P2.justification: The document is globally reformatted in NeurIPS style, with repositioned displays and full-width annotated Algorithms 1–2 replacing wrapped listings. Figure 1 incorporates the existing filtering steps; Tables 14–15 and Figure 11 are added. Former Tables 14–15 become Tables 16–17.

improvement.justification: The added backbone comparisons, independent-MST control and stepwise hierarchy visualization provide useful support for applicability and joint refinement. The expanded diagram and interpretability discussion also improve explanation. These are limited gains with the core results and proofs unchanged; F.13 additionally overstates consistent improvement despite the two lower LP means in Table 14.
